svg.title: CO2-Response: the Uno R4 build on a half-size breadboard
svg.text: CO2-Response · the whole Uno R4 build on a half-size breadboard (rows 1-30, columns a-j), hole by hole

Drawn on its side: turn the page so row 1 is at the top and it matches an upright board. A hole is column letter + row number (j12). The five holes a12-e12 are joined inside the board; the centre channel separates them from f12-j12.
Each rail runs the full length of the board. W = wire, numbered as in docs/wiring.md. Each wire has its own colour, and its number sits on the hole at each end. Wires that only cross are not joined.
Q1 IRLZ44N: G f7 · D f8 · S f9
female ends of the jumpers on its header
flow sensor, in the breathing circuit
cable: no wires to the breadboard
on the valve; magnet on its handle
its own 2 leads → g15, g17 (either way)
top view · USB-C on the left
D13 LED = alarm light (nothing to wire)
Micro-B: computer side · USB-A: device side
≤100 mA: the Uno and its breadboard 5 V
nothing on the breadboard goes to it
Never join the two + rails: they are different supplies.
Both − rails are GND and must be joined (W20).
Any hole of a rail will do: the rows named ("by row 4") are only where
the drawing puts each wire end. The holes of a rail are all joined.
in: W18 from J1's end pin · out: W11 SprintIR-R VDD, W15 pump +
in: W19 from J1's middle pin · joined to the j-side − rail by W20
in: W2 Arduino GND · out: W5 shifter, W13 Q1 source, R2, W17 reed switch
in: W1 Arduino 5V · out: W4 shifter HV
Every wire, end to end (hole = column letter + row number, as printed on the breadboard)
Arduino 5V (power header) → + rail (j side), by row 30
Arduino GND (power header) → − rail (j side), by row 30
+ rail (j side), by row 26 → j25 (shifter HV)
− rail (j side), by row 28 → j26 (shifter GND, 5 V side)
a26 (shifter GND, 3 V side) → SprintIR-R pin 3 GND
+ rail (a side), by row 28 → SprintIR-R pin 4 VDD
Arduino D10 → j3 (R1, then Q1's gate)
j9 (Q1 source) → − rail (j side), by row 10
Pump + contact → + rail (a side), by row 10
j17 (other reed lead) → − rail (j side), by row 18
a3 (J1 end pin, +) → + rail (a side), by row 4
a5 (J1 middle pin, −) → − rail (a side), by row 6
− rail (a side), by row 2 → − rail (j side), by row 2

Parts in holes: J1 c3/c5/c7 · Q1 IRLZ44N f7 G, f8 D, f9 S (printed side towards column j) · R1 220 Ω h3-h7 · R2 100 kΩ i7 → − rail (j side) · U1 shifter A side d23-d28, B side g23-g28 · reed switch leads g15, g17

Check the shifter's printed pin names against this order (A1 A2 LV GND A3 A4 / B1 B2 HV GND B3 B4) and keep each wire on the column of the named pin. Rows 11-14, 19-22, 29-30 are free. Not in the purchase documents: the breadboard, jumper wires and USB cables C1, C2; R1, R2, D1 only as the electronics component kit.
